main_text.head: Cap.14. De Lapidibus regularibus &anomalis+
main_text.l: 15. De Animato corpore, ejusq; Vita & Morte.
16. De Anima vegetante, nutrice, auctrice, procreatrice.
17. Phytologia, de Plantis & stirpibus, earumque partibus.
19. Dendrographia, quæ est arborum doctrina generalis, & Botanologia, quæ est Herbarum.
20o+ De plantarum viribus ac facultatibus paulo specialius ad Medicos spectantibus.
21. Zoographia, de anima sentiente, & animalium sensu in genere.
22. De sensibus exterioribus, Visu, gustu, tactu olfactu & auditu.
23. De sensibus interioribus, sensu communi, Phantasia, Memoria, ubi de Somno.
26. De Brutorum distinctione. THERIOLOGIA, Anthropologiæ pars prima, scilicet.
27. PSYCHOLOGIA Humana, seu de anima hominis rationali: Ubi de Intellectu.
30. Altera pars Anthropologiæ, Somatotomia Corporis humani, spiritu, calore, & humido innato.
32. Osteologia, seu Humanorum ossium Sceleton. Constat hoc caput 14. Sectionibus+

page.notes: The number 20 is followed by a small ring-like mark, transcribed as "o"; this is doubtful. Small-capital words (THERIOLOGIA, PSYCHOLOGIA) are shown in capitals. The "+" marks after "anomalis", "20" and "Sectionibus" are printed reference signs. Line 33 is cut off at the foot of the page. The "Cap.14." line is treated as the heading of the list.
